I added a "Reset Health" button to `res://scripts/player.gd` using `@export_tool_button`, which calls a new `reset_health()` method that sets `health = max_health`. I couldn't run Godot here, so none of this has been run or checked in the editor.

To make the button work I added `@tool` to the script. That makes the script run in the editor, so `_physics_process` now returns early when `Engine.is_editor_hint()` is true and gameplay behaves as before.
